title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far

description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra defended the mandatory stock listing framework for large non-banking financial companies and core investment companies, emphasizing the necessity of safeguarding public funds and mitigating systemic financial risks. His remarks directly address the ongoing regulatory situation surrounding Tata Sons, which was classified as an Upper Layer NBFC due to its massive asset size and indirect access to public funds.
